001.name: Little Mushroom House
001.desc: A small but cozy mushroom house. You can feel the history in this place.

002.name: Cozy Mushroom House Plan A
002.desc: A cozy two-story mushroom house of average size. It would look right at home in Henesys. A stairwell provides access to the second floor.

003.name: Cozy Mushroom House Plan B
003.desc: A cozy two-story mushroom house of average size. It would look right at home in Henesys. A sleek-looking staircase has been placed conveniently near the entryway.

004.name: Cozy Mushroom House Plan C
004.desc: A cozy two-story mushroom house of average size. It would look right at home in Henesys. Utilizes quaint ladders to maximize floor space.

005.name: Colonial-Style Home Plan A
005.desc: An extravagant two-story colonial-style manor with looselyCommerci-inspired architecture.\r\nA modern-quarter staircase grants access to the upper floor.

006.name: Colonial-Style Home Plan B
006.desc: An extravagant two-story colonial-style manor with looselyCommerci-inspired architecture.\r\nA decadent straight staircase near the front door grants access to the upper level.

007.name: Colonial-Style Home Plan C
007.desc: An extravagant two-story colonial-style manor with loosely Commerci-inspired architecture.\r\nA stylish ladder grants access to the upper floor while conserving floor space.

008.name: Halloween Manor - Grand Staircases
008.desc: A classic, three-story manor with a decidedly spooky vibe. The centrally-located grand staircase really classes the place up.\r\nIt's the perfect place to throw a murder mystery party.

009.name: Halloween Manor - Quarter Staircases
009.desc: A classic, three-story manor with a decidedly spooky vibe. A set of quarter staircases provide stylish, yet practical access to the upper levels.

010.name: Halloween Manor - Ladders
010.desc: A classic, three-story manor with a decidedly spooky vibe. A set of ladders grant entry to the upper floors, conserving floor space.\r\nA great place to throw a Halloween party while keeping your personal space private!

011.name: Eastern-Style Home - Normal
011.desc: A beautiful Eastern-style estate surrounded by an array of charming trees and a tranquil lotus pond. A bridge traverses the water, providing access to a covered observation deck\r\nThe pond is so clear that walking on crossing the bridge, one can't help but feel they're walking on air.

012.name: Beach Townhouse - Straight Staircases
012.desc: A luxurious two-story seaside villa where the relaxing sound of waves crashing in the distance can always be heard. Features a rooftop terrace perfect for lounging in the sun. A simple, straight staircase divides the downstairs space and grants access to the upper level.

013.name: Beach Townhouse - Quarter Staircases
